title: Design System: rndyt TUI Reading Session

label.purpose: Paths, commands, metadata, tabs, and status.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.value: color .16s ease, background .16s ease, border-color .16s ease
motion.purpose: Small state changes for links, panes, tabs, and output rows.

motion.name: cursor-blink
motion.purpose: One terminal cursor cue; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Terminal Navigation
components.description: A real link styled as a cd command with an explicit active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:inline-flex; min-height:32px; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:4px 9px; border:1px solid transparent; color:#7D8D9C; background:transparent; font:400 .72rem/1.4 'SFMono-Regular', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav::before { content:'cd '; color:#7D8D9C; } .ds-nav:hover, .ds-nav[aria-current='page'] { color:#D7FF6A; border-color:#293644; background:#10161E; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #D7FF6A; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Terminal Pane
components.description: A square terminal surface with a label, path, and structural border.
components.css: .ds-pane { padding:16px; border:1px solid #293644; background:#10161E; color:#E8EDF2; } .ds-label { display:block; margin-bottom:14px; color:#7D8D9C; font:400 .7rem/1.4 'SFMono-Regular', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-label::before { content:'# '; color:#45586C; } .ds-pane strong { color:#D7FF6A; font-weight:500; }

components.name: Output Tag
components.description: A square metadata tag used in output rows and project records.
components.css: .ds-tag { display:inline-flex; min-height:21px; align-items:center; padding:1px 6px; border:1px solid #293644; color:#7D8D9C; background:#10161E; font:400 .63rem/1.4 'SFMono-Regular', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-tag::before { content:'#'; color:#45586C; }

components.name: Replay Tab
components.description: A keyboard-navigable process step with an active stdout state.
components.css: .ds-tab { min-height:35px; padding:6px 9px; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; color:#7D8D9C; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; font:400 .66rem/1.4 'SFMono-Regular', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-tab:hover { color:#B8C3CE; background:#1A2632; } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { color:#D7FF6A; border-bottom-color:#D7FF6A; background:#1A2632; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #D7FF6A; outline-offset:-2px; }

narrative.northStar: A tmux reading desk for engineering judgment.
narrative.overview: rndyt is presented as a persistent shell session. Paths, commands, pane borders, stdout-like summaries, and status labels make the site easy to scan without turning the content into fake terminal roleplay. Pixel character comes from a fixed-width cell discipline and discrete cursor/selection states.

rules.name: ANSI Rarity Rule
rules.body: Accent colors identify state or affordance; they never wash whole surfaces.

rules.name: Command/Content Rule
rules.body: Mono labels orient the reader; prose remains normal technical writing.

rules.name: Flat Buffer Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from tonal layers and borders, not shadows or glow.

dos: Use functional paths and command-like labels.
Keep content rows and panes consistent across routes.
donts: Do not use hardware-display or arcade metaphors as the primary structure.
Do not use gradients, scanline overlays, or rounded card walls.
Do not hide real links behind terminal decoration.
